Android tablet from Oppo

Oppo Pad Air is an Android-based tablet produced by Oppo and was released on May 23, 2022.[1]

Specifications

Hardware

Chipset

The Oppo Pad Air is powered by 4x2.4 GHz Kryo 265 Gold & 4x1.9 GHz Kryo 265 Silver octa-core processors with Snapdragon 680. The SoC is based on the 6 nm processing technology node. The tablet also feature an Adreno 610 GPU.[2][3]

Storage

The Oppo Pad Air has a MicroSD for extra storage and is available in 64GB of ROM and 4GB of RAM, 128GB of ROM and 4GB of RAM, and 128GB of ROM and 6GB of RAM.[4]

Camera

The Oppo Pad Air have a 8 MP rear camera with an f/2.0 lens. The front has a 5 MP, f/2.2 lens.[5]

Display

The Oppo Pad Air is equipped with an IPS LCD display with an 10.36-inch 1200 x 2000 resolution, with a screen ratio of 5:3.[6]

Battery

The Oppo Pad Air is equipped with a 7100 mAh Li-Po battery. This battery is featured with 18W fast charging.[7]

Software

The Oppo Pad Neo operates on ColorOS 12.1 which based on the Android 12 operating system

Software

The Oppo Pad Air is equipped with ColorOS 12.1 which based on the Android 12 operating system.[8]
